weekly.pulse:
**Weekly Product Pulse | 2026-08-22 to 2026-08-29** (366 reviews, avg 3.24/5)

**Top themes**
- App performance & bugs: 191 reviews (52.2%), 53.9% rated 1-2★
- Mutual funds & SIP: 55 reviews (15.0%), 3.6% rated 1-2★
- Ease of use & positive experience: 44 reviews (12.0%), 6.8% rated 1-2★

**What users say**
- "The new update is really bad. Every time you open the chart then a scalper option appears below instead of an earlier touch screen panel." (R50, 1★)
- "groww app good experience all funds excellent app thank you 💓 grow app" (R999, 5★)
- "Easy To Use....Very Helpfull App...Thanks Groww App....For our Growth....." (R708, 5★)

**Key observation**
21 reviews (5.7%) mention brokerage & trade charges; 16 are 1-2★ and 11 use confusion words (hidden, extra, unclear, comparisons with other apps).

**Support desk signal**
- "Groww brokerage and charges" asked 8 times this week.
- "HDFC scheme exit load" asked 5 times this week.

**Action ideas**
1. Show a full charge breakup (brokerage, taxes, statutory charges) before the order is confirmed.
2. Add a "why was I charged?" link beside every ledger and contract-note line.
3. Give support one approved fee explainer and track charge-related questions weekly.

bullets.text: Brokerage is the fee the broker charges for each executed equity order; Groww publishes its current rates on its pricing page.
Brokerage is not the only cost: statutory charges such as STT, exchange transaction charges, GST, SEBI turnover fees and stamp duty are added by regulation and are not set by the broker.
Selling delivery shares also attracts depository (DP) charges, applied per sell order, not per stock.
Charges apply per executed order, so splitting one trade into several orders can increase the total fee.

Groww's Help Centre lists the charges that appear in a delivery trade report: brokerage, DP charges, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover charges, the investor protection fund charge, STT and GST.
Groww's delivery brokerage is the lower of a flat fee or a percentage of the order value, subject to a minimum; the exact figures are on the pricing page.
